<article class="tower-card">
  <div class="tower-card-image"><img src="https://tds.wiki/images/{{{image|}}}" alt="{{{1|Tower}}}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none'"></div>
  <div class="tower-card-info">
    <span class="tower-card-tier">{{{tier|Tower}}}</span>
    <strong class="tower-card-name">[[{{{1|Unknown}}}]]</strong>
    <div class="tower-card-unlock">{{#if:{{{unlock|}}}|Unlock: {{{unlock}}}|}}</div>
    <div class="tower-card-cost">{{#if:{{{price|}}}|Cost: {{{price}}} {{{currency|Coins}}}|{{{label|}}}}}</div>
    <div class="tower-card-note">{{{note|}}}</div>
  </div>
</article>
